derivation.method: Authored from the pinned Steel Compendium only (canonical checkout at the main repo vendor/steel-compendium, HEAD fb83a789 verified with git rev-parse). Level-one baselines copied from tests/fixtures/v99-censor-expected.json (reviewed). No evaluator, content, convex or headless code read or run.
derivation.staminaMaximum: Censor Basics: Starting Stamina 21 + 9 per level after 1st; kit Stamina bonus per echelon (chapter/kits.md Stamina Bonus); levels 1-3 are echelon 1 (rule/general/echelon.md "1st Echelon (1st to 3rd Level)"). Kit Stamina: Cloak and Dagger +3, Mountain +9, Sniper none, Swashbuckler +3 (chapter/kits.md kit table) - consistent with v99 level-one values.
derivation.noNumericSheetChange: EXPLICIT: no level-2 or level-3 Censor feature (Perk; Saint's Vigilance, A Sense for Truth, It Was Foretold, Judge of Character, Lead by Example, Stalwart Icon; 2nd-Level Order Ability; Look On My Work and Despair; 7-Wrath Ability), no order ability, no 7-wrath ability and none of the selected perks changes any numeric sheet value (recoveries, speed, stability, disengage, characteristics, potency, size). The only numeric changes are Stamina maximum (+9 per level) and the recovery/winded values derived from it. Characteristic Increase first appears at 4th level; kit Stamina scales only at echelon 2 (level 4).
derivation.abilityCounts: Advancement table: level 2 adds one 5-wrath order ability (Abilities Signature, 3, 5; Order Abilities 5); level 3 adds one 7-wrath ability (Abilities Signature, 3, 5, 7).
derivation.orderFeatures: 2nd-Level Order Features grants TWO features per order: Exorcist - Saint's Vigilance, A Sense for Truth; Oracle - It Was Foretold, Judge of Character; Paragon - Lead by Example, Stalwart Icon.
derivation.abilityDamage: "X + M" / "X + P" add the Might / Presence score (all witnesses M2, P2). Kit damage bonus added only for Melee+Weapon or Ranged+Weapon damage-dealing abilities (chapter/kits.md Damage Bonuses): only Sentenced qualifies. Fixed (non-rolled) damage recorded under fixedDamageByWitness.
derivation.potency: Censor potency weak P-2 / average P-1 / strong P = 0/1/2 with Presence 2 (class/censor.md; rule/character/potency.md).
derivation.perkChoice: One distinct eligible perk per witness, none with sub-choices, none already owned (all bases own only Teamwork, an exploration perk).

uncertainties.resolution: Grouping from en/books/heroes/clean/Draw Steel Heroes.md lines 4995-5080: Exorcist: It Is Justice You Fear (4999), Revelator (5015); Oracle: Prescient Grace (5029), With My Blessing (5041); Paragon: Blessing of the Faithful (5055), Sentenced (5065). Unified ability front matter "subclass" agrees for all six.

uncertainties.passage: it-is-justice-you-fear.md Effect: "If the target is already frightened of you or another creature and this ability would frighten them again, they instead take psychic damage equal to twice your Presence score."
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: "instead" replaces only the frightened result; the tier holy damage (10/14/17) is still dealt, plus 4 psychic when the potency check would frighten an already-frightened target.
alternatives: the psychic damage replaces the whole tier result including holy damage
psychic damage applies whenever the target is already frightened regardless of the potency check

uncertainties.passage: look-on-my-work-and-despair.md: "...if the new target has P < STRONG, they are frightened of you (save ends). If the target is already frightened of you, they instead take holy damage equal to twice your Presence score."
uncertainties.resolution: Not resolved; kept manual. Sentence placement suggests it modifies the free-triggered retarget clause only.
alternatives: applies only to the retarget clause (P < STRONG)
applies to both the 1-wrath Judgment clause and the retarget clause

uncertainties.passage: edict-of-disruptive-isolation.md: "A target takes an extra 2d6 holy damage if they are judged by you or if they are adjacent to any enemy."
uncertainties.resolution: Not resolved; kept manual. "Enemy" is ambiguous in perspective.
alternatives: adjacent to any of the target's enemies (i.e. the censor's allies/heroes)
adjacent to any of the censor's enemies (i.e. the target's allies)

uncertainties.passage: edict-of-stillness.md: "whenever a target moves or is force moved out of the area ... A target judged by you who moves willingly takes an extra 2d6 holy damage."
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: "out of the area" qualifies both "moves" and "is force moved"; the 2d6 extra requires judged + willing movement out of the area.
alternatives: any movement by the target (even within the aura) triggers the base damage

uncertainties.passage: edict-of-perfect-order.md references abilities that cost Malice "(see Draw Steel: Monsters)".
uncertainties.resolution: Trigger depends on monster data; kept manual. Fixed damage 3 x P = 6 holy (+2d6 if judged).

uncertainties.passage: chapter/kits.md Damage Bonuses require Melee+Weapon or Ranged+Weapon keywords and rolled damage.
uncertainties.resolution: Only Sentenced (Melee, Weapon) receives a kit bonus (v99-war Mountain +0/+0/+4). It Is Justice You Fear (no Weapon), Revelator and the four edicts (Area, Magic; fixed damage) receive none; no ranged distance bonus applies to any level-2/3 ability.

uncertainties.passage: prescient-grace.md: "You can spend a Recovery to allow the target to regain Stamina equal to your recovery value."
uncertainties.resolution: Reading: the censor spends the censor's Recovery and the amount is the censor's recovery value (possessive "your").
alternatives: target's recovery value (not supported by text)

orderFeatures.name: Saint's Vigilance
orderFeatures.summary: You have honed your ability to detect sin and can use it to find those who hide from justice. Any creature judged by you can't use the Hide maneuver. Additionally, you gain an edge when searching for hidden creatures. If you find a hidden creature, you can use your Judgment ability against them as a free triggered action.

orderFeatures.name: A Sense for Truth
orderFeatures.summary: You are trained in secret techniques from your order that allow you to discern the truth with supernatural precision. If a creature is of a lower level than you, you automatically know when they are lying, though you don't necessarily know the actual truth behind their lie. Additionally, you gain an edge on tests made to detect lies or hidden motives.

automaticFeatures.name: Look On My Work and Despair
automaticFeatures.summary: Your judgment has grown in divine power, instilling fear in those you condemn. Whenever you use your Judgment ability, you can spend 1 wrath, and if the target has P < AVERAGE, they are frightened of you (save ends). Additionally, whenever a creature judged by you is reduced to 0 Stamina and you use Judgment as a free triggered action, if the new target has P < STRONG, they are frightened of you (save ends). If the target is already frightened of you, they instead take holy damage equal to twice your Presence score.
manualClauses: Whenever you use Judgment you can spend 1 wrath; if the target has P < AVERAGE (Presence-based potency: average = P-1 = 1 for every witness), they are frightened of you (save ends).

Whenever a creature judged by you is reduced to 0 Stamina and you use Judgment as a free triggered action, if the new target has P < STRONG (= 2 for every witness), they are frightened of you (save ends).
If the target is already frightened of you, they instead take holy damage equal to twice your Presence score (2 x 2 = 4 for every witness); scope of this sentence is an uncertainty.
